differences_from_earlier_campaign: Lean 4.35.0 with Mathlib 56a00585 instead of Lean 4.34.0 with Mathlib 5ed29652
Nine trials instead of three, alternating AB, BA, and so on, so trials 1 to 3 follow the earlier AB, BA, AB protocol
CPU 88 instead of CPU 4 of the same CPU model

Driver patch: DriverSupport.lean gains the two-word storage case `| .pair _ _ => fun value => value.raw.1.lo`, which binary128 selects since October 2026. The earlier driver does not build against 2.0.0, and its binary128 observation converted the proof model to bits
run.py and runner.py accept --trials, and build.py and lean-toolchain pin Lean 4.35.0
Some timed windows ran under the 40 ms target because trials ran faster than calibration: 99 of 1,512 rows are below 36 ms, the shortest is 22.2 ms, the median is 40.1 ms
measured.later_code: FloatLib 3.0.0 was not timed. Comparing the code Lean generates for 8c88715 and 3.0.0, we found the same arithmetic on these timed paths: the changes there are erased proof arguments, renamed parameters, and documentation, and the compiled code differs in small details such as instruction order
measured.load_average: 30 to 150 on the host during the session
measured.machine: Intel Xeon Platinum 8275CL, 96 logical CPUs, shared with other work
measured.source: git archive of 8c88715, built with Lean 4.35.0 and Mathlib 56a00585
measured.unchanged: fixtures and their input hashes, MPFR 4.1.0-p13 with GMP 6.2.1, GCC 11.5.0, CPU model, 40 ms target, 512 warmup calls, 4,194,304 iteration cap

arms.mpfr: MPFR with matching precision, exponent range, and rounding

measurements.host_identifiers: Anonymous host label; CPU and affinity are retained.

protocol.consumption: Each output feeds a checked low-64-bit FNV checksum.
protocol.input_selection: Fixed descending cyclic index; counts are whole sixteen-input cycles.
protocol.pairing: Both arms share one pinned CPU; execution order alternates AB, BA, AB, BA, AB, BA, AB, BA, AB.
protocol.preparation: Parsing, operand construction, and full-encoding checks precede timing.
